description: OpenBMB tokenizer-free TTS model supporting 30 languages and 9 Chinese dialects, with 48 kHz output, natural-language voice design, controllable short-reference voice cloning, and expressive style guidance.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript for prompt/reference audio in ultimate-cloning and continuation-style prompts.

request.name: min_tokens
request.description: Minimum generated acoustic patches before EOS can stop generation; default 2.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated acoustic patches; default 4096, and 0 requests the model config max_length.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Local DiT/CFM inference steps per generated patch; default 10.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Classifier-free guidance scale for local DiT/CFM generation; default 2.0.

request.name: retry_badcase
request.description: Retry over-long offline generations detected by the patch/text ratio; default true, but streaming requests must set false.

request.name: retry_badcase_max_times
request.description: Maximum retry attempts for bad-case detection; default 3.

request.name: retry_badcase_ratio_threshold
request.description: Generated-patch to target-text-token ratio threshold for bad-case detection; must be positive, default 6.0.

request.name: noise_path
request.description: F32 CFM noise file for deterministic acoustic patch replay.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum UTF-8 codepoints per offline text chunk; default 2048.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Use tighter graph workspaces and release request runtime graphs; default false.

session.name: prompt_cache_slots
session.description: Prompt and prompt-audio embedding cache slots; default 1.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: MiniCPM, local encoder, projection, and DiT weight storage type; default native.

session.name: audiovae_weight_type
session.description: AudioVAE weight storage type; default f32.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Shared generator weight context size in MiB; default 3072.

session.name: text_embedding_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Text embedding graph arena size in MiB; default 64.

session.name: lm_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: MiniCPM LM step graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: projection_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Step projection graph arena size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: local_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Local encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: dit_graph_arena_mb
session.description: DiT estimator graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: audiovae_weight_context_mb
session.description: AudioVAE weight context size in MiB; default 768.

session.name: audiovae_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AudioVAE decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: audiovae_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AudioVAE prompt encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: audiovae_latent_capacity
session.description: AudioVAE decoder latent-frame graph capacity; default 0 fits each request.

session.name: audiovae_encoder_sample_capacity
session.description: AudioVAE prompt encoder sample capacity; must be positive and divisible by the encoder stride, default 240000.
